spiritLevel.name: Spirit level
spiritLevel.description: The frame's accelerometer as a spirit level: a bullseye lying flat, a tube along the level side standing up, with the angle in degrees. A tap zeroes it, a long press takes the zero away. Without an accelerometer it shows a demo.
